required_checks: current assessment and preflight are recomputed rather than trusting a supplied PASS file
independent PASS receipt is mandatory and bound to reviewed commit plus exact contract and tool hashes
split file, method registry, job specification, aggregate receipts and input inventory freeze hashes are exact
observed measurement and driver-log source sets must equal preregistered hashes after CONSUMED and before parsing
dedicated output directory and four fixed artifacts cannot alias or traverse symlinks
CONSUMED is O_EXCL and durably fsynced before the first BLIND read
receipt and sidecar are durably published before RELEASED and incomplete states are rejected
crash or failure after CONSUMED cannot be replayed
MISSING_RESULT_PATH is included in the formal R07 denominator and fails coverage
HF/HMF action key excludes F and outcomes
success and failure releases contain no runtime values outcomes paths run IDs or candidate rows
negative tests cover stale or forged gates, input substitution, tool substitution, path aliases and crash windows
real execution has not occurred during review
